title: GPTNT：多模态智能体实时协作基准测试
summary: GPTNT是基于合作游戏《Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes》构建的基准测试，要求两个智能体在实时、信息不对称和压力下协作拆弹。测试表明，当前最先进的闭源和开源模型均无法实时拆弹，而人类玩家可以。该基准揭示了模型在状态追踪、时间压力下高效行动、歧义处理和错误恢复方面的关键弱点。
summary_en: GPTNT is a benchmark built on the cooperative game Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, requiring two agents to collaborate in real-time under information asymmetry and time pressure. Current state-of-the-art models fail to defuse a single bomb in real time, while human players succeed. The benchmark reveals critical weaknesses in state tracking, efficient action under time pressure, ambiguity handling, and error recovery.
